subject: OPM - Advanced eLearning for the Federal Human Resources - MRAS

subject: Reminder: GSA OGP - Phishing Resistant Authenticator - MRAS
description: The Office of Technology Policy and Federal Identity and Cybersecurity (FICS) Division is developing a product criteria to identify vendor products that are phishing resistant as outlined in OMB Memo 22-09. Phishing resistant is defined as an authentication method that is resistant to interception or replay attacks. The intent of this market research is to help federal agencies identify and aggressively replace insufficient authentication methods with either phishing-resistant or passwordless methods.
